answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fake identities. Each agent locks a 150 POA onyx-sealed deposit to claim one of 40 work slots per epoch; the timber ledger lists every claim. Three rotating auditors check the work, and a fake job burns the whole deposit. An attacker minting 1,000 identities pays 1,000 x 150 = 150,000 POA, all burned, while honest agents pay once and earn the full 150 POA reward from the shared oasis of verified work.
